__meta.note: Authoritative text. Every other privacy locale is a translation of this one and is informational only.

strings.privacy.translationNotice: This translation is provided for information only. The English version is the official privacy policy.
strings.privacy.scireplDesignedBePrivacyRespecti: SciREPL is designed to be a privacy-respecting application. All code execution happens locally on your device. We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal data to our servers.
strings.privacy.scireplStoresFollowingDataLocall: SciREPL stores data locally on your device using browser or app storage, including localStorage, IndexedDB, and caches:
strings.privacy.yourSessionHistoryCodeCells: Your session history (code cells and their types)
strings.privacy.sharedVfsAndUserFiles: SharedVFS files, uploaded files, installed package files, and search paths
strings.privacy.cachedResources: Downloaded runtimes, packages, and app resources kept in local caches
strings.privacy.dataNeverLeavesYourDevice: SciREPL does not send this local data to its servers. You can clear session and VFS data via Menu > Clear History, and downloaded caches via Menu > Memory & Storage.
strings.privacy.scireplBundlesCoreRuntimes: SciREPL bundles its core interface and most language runtimes directly in the app. The following items describe what is bundled and what may be downloaded from third-party services:
strings.privacy.bundledLanguageRuntimes: Bundled language runtimes: Python (Pyodide), Prolog (SWI-Prolog WASM), ClojureScript (Scittle), Bash (brush-wasm), TypR, and JavaScript are included with the Free app and do not require a runtime download.
strings.privacy.webrRRuntimeFrom: R (webR) — about 50 MB from webr.r-wasm.org, downloaded when R is first used and cached locally.
strings.privacy.fengariLuaRuntimeFrom: Lua (Fengari) — from cdn.jsdelivr.net or unpkg.com, downloaded when Lua is first used and cached locally.
strings.privacy.docxLibraryFrom: DOCX export library — docx@9.6.0 from cdn.jsdelivr.net, downloaded when DOCX export is first used.
strings.privacy.policyRuntimeVersionChecks: Runtime version checks — after network consent, opening Languages may query data.jsdelivr.com for package version metadata. If consent has not yet been given, tapping Check latest opens the consent dialog; no metadata request is sent unless you accept. It does not download or activate the runtime.
strings.privacy.additionalPackagesFromNetwork: Optional catalog packages are downloaded from GitHub when you install them. Other packages and user-requested data may be fetched from package repositories or URLs when you request them, for example with install.packages(), %pip, or file-fetching commands.
strings.privacy.koFiSupportLink: Ko-fi support link — Help includes a normal link to ko-fi.com. No Ko-fi request is made unless you choose to open it.
strings.privacy.whenTheseResourcesFetchedCdn: When these resources are fetched, the CDN providers may receive:
strings.privacy.yourDeviceSUserAgent: Your device's user agent string (browser/OS information)
strings.privacy.cachingUsedMinimizeConnectionsCd: Caching is used to minimize repeat connections. After a runtime or package has been downloaded successfully, SciREPL uses the local cached copy when available.
strings.privacy.yourCodeSessionData: Your code, session data, and exported files are not transmitted to a SciREPL server. Network requests occur only for the resources described above or when your code explicitly requests them.
strings.privacy.scireplProvidesFileFetchingFeatu: SciREPL provides a file-fetching feature that allows notebook code to download files from URLs you specify. When you use this feature (e.g., fetch_file in Prolog, or via the Prolog Settings panel), the request is made directly from your device to the specified URL. The remote server will receive your IP address and standard HTTP headers. SciREPL does not proxy, log, or monitor these requests.
strings.privacy.allCodeYouEnter: Code you enter in the included Python, Prolog, Bash, JavaScript, R, Lua, TypR, and ClojureScript kernels is executed locally on your device. No code is sent to a SciREPL server for execution.
strings.privacy.whenYouExportNotebookIpynb: When you export a notebook (.ipynb), the file is created locally on your device. If you choose to share it (via the system share sheet), the destination is determined by your choice. SciREPL does not control or monitor where you share exported files.
strings.privacy.scireplDoesNotIncludeAny: SciREPL does not include any analytics, crash reporting, advertising SDKs, or tracking mechanisms.
strings.privacy.scireplDoesNotKnowinglyCollect: SciREPL does not knowingly collect any information from children. The app does not require account creation or collect personal information of any kind.
strings.privacy.ifAdditionalLanguageRuntimesAdde: If a future release changes which runtimes or packages are bundled or downloaded, this policy will be updated to describe the resulting network requests and metadata exposure.
strings.privacy.mitWarranty: THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND NONINFRINGEMENT. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM, OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE THEREOF.
strings.privacy.youUseScireplEntirelyAt: You use SciREPL entirely at your own risk. Code execution occurs locally on your device and the developers are not responsible for any consequences of code you choose to run.
